cn_steps: 启用 `Rig Mapper`（模块 `RigMapperEditor`、`RigMapper`、`RigMapperDeveloper`）。
它提供一组动画重映射功能（把曲线/骨骼映射到另一套绑定）。
用 Rig Mapper 定义映射，再接到重定向或动画混合流程。
属实验性动画工具；编辑器模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Rig Mapper` (modules `RigMapperEditor`, `RigMapper`, `RigMapperDeveloper`).
It provides a set of animation remapping features (map curves/bones onto another rig).
Author a Rig Mapper definition, then feed it into retargeting or animation-mix flows.
It is an experimental animation tool; editor modules are Editor-target only.
note_cn: 动画曲线/骨骼重映射工具集。
note_en: Animation remapping features (curves/bones onto another rig).

cn_steps: 启用 `RigLogic for UAF`（模块 `RigLogicUAF`、`RigLogicUAFUncookedOnly`）。
它把 RigLogic 面部解算接到 Unreal Animation Framework (UAF)。
在 UAF 角色管线里驱动 DNA/面部，而不是只走旧 AnimBP 路径。
需 RigLogic 主插件；未煮熟模块只进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `RigLogic for UAF` (modules `RigLogicUAF`, `RigLogicUAFUncookedOnly`).
It wires RigLogic facial evaluation into the Unreal Animation Framework (UAF).
Drive DNA/face on UAF character pipelines instead of only the legacy AnimBP path.
Requires the main RigLogic plugin; uncooked modules are Editor-target only.
note_cn: 把 RigLogic 面部解算接到 UAF。

cn_steps: 启用 `RigLogic Plugin`（模块 `RigLogicLib`、`RigLogicLibTest`、`RigLogicModule`、`RigLogicDeveloper`、`RigLogicEditor`）。
它是面部动画的 RigLogic 运行时（DNA 驱动的面部解算，常用于 MetaHuman）。
把 DNA 资产接到骨骼网格，运行时由 RigLogic 解算面部。
Game 模块依赖 `RigLogicModule`；编辑器/测试模块只进对应 Target。
en_steps: Enable `RigLogic Plugin` (modules `RigLogicLib`, `RigLogicLibTest`, `RigLogicModule`, `RigLogicDeveloper`, `RigLogicEditor`).
It is the RigLogic runtime for facial animation (DNA-driven face eval, commonly MetaHuman).
Attach a DNA asset to a skeletal mesh; RigLogic evaluates the face at runtime.
Game modules depend on `RigLogicModule`; editor/test modules go to matching targets only.
note_cn: 面部动画 RigLogic 运行时（DNA/MetaHuman）。

cn_steps: 启用 `RigMapper Op`（模块 `RigMapperOp`）。
它是用 RigMapper 定义重映射曲线的实验性 Retarget Op。
在重定向图里加入该 Op，按 RigMapper 定义改曲线。
属实验性重定向扩展；需 Rig Mapper。
en_steps: Enable `RigMapper Op` (module `RigMapperOp`).
It is an experimental Retarget Op that remaps curves using RigMapper definitions.
Add this op in a retarget graph to remap curves from a RigMapper definition.
It is an experimental retarget extension; requires Rig Mapper.
note_cn: 用 RigMapper 定义重映射曲线的 Retarget Op。
note_en: Retarget Op that remaps curves via RigMapper definitions.

cn_steps: 启用 `RigVM Tests`（测试内容插件，无独立运行时模块列表）。
它是 RigVM 图模型的 MTF 测试。
跑这些测试来校验 RigVM 图的前端/后端行为。
属测试插件；需 RigVM。
en_steps: Enable `RigVM Tests` (test-content plugin; no separate runtime module list).
It is MTF tests for the RigVM graph model.
Run these tests to validate RigVM graph frontend/backend behavior.
It is a test plugin; requires RigVM.
note_cn: RigVM 图模型的 MTF 测试。
note_en: MTF tests for the RigVM graph model.

cn_steps: 启用 `RigVM`（模块 `RigVM`、`RigVMDeveloper`、`RigVMEditor`）。
它提供 RigVM 可视化编程语言与运行时的前端和后端（Control Rig 等的虚拟机）。
作为 Control Rig / Rig 图的底层依赖，一般不要单独当游戏功能开关。
Game 模块依赖 `RigVM`；开发者/编辑器模块只进对应 Target。
en_steps: Enable `RigVM` (modules `RigVM`, `RigVMDeveloper`, `RigVMEditor`).
It provides the frontend and backend for the RigVM visual language and runtime (the VM behind Control Rig and similar graphs).
A low-level dependency for Control Rig / rig graphs; not a gameplay toggle by itself.
Game modules depend on `RigVM`; developer/editor modules go to matching targets only.
note_cn: RigVM 可视化语言与运行时的前端/后端。
note_en: Frontend and backend for the RigVM visual language and runtime.

cn_steps: 启用 `RivermaxCore`（模块 `RivermaxCore`、`RivermaxEditor`、`RivermaxRendering`）。
它是把 NVIDIA Rivermax 暴露给引擎的基础插件（高质量、低延迟的视频/数据网卡传输）。
在虚拟制片 SMPTE 2110/Rivermax 工作流里作为底层依赖启用。
属 VP/IO 基础层；需 Rivermax 驱动与网卡。
en_steps: Enable `RivermaxCore` (modules `RivermaxCore`, `RivermaxEditor`, `RivermaxRendering`).
It is the base plugin exposing NVIDIA Rivermax to the engine (high-quality, low-latency NIC video/data transport).
Enable it as a low-level dependency in virtual-production SMPTE 2110/Rivermax workflows.
It is a VP/IO foundation layer; requires Rivermax drivers and NIC.
note_cn: 把 NVIDIA Rivermax 暴露给引擎的基础插件。
note_en: Base plugin exposing NVIDIA Rivermax to the engine.

cn_steps: 启用 `RTSP Media`（运行时 `RTSPMedia`，编辑器 `RTSPMediaEditor`）。
它通过 RTSP 协议做实时媒体流（拉流到 Media Framework）。
创建 RTSP Media Source，填 URL，在关卡里播实时摄像头/编码器流。
属媒体播放扩展；需 Media Framework。
en_steps: Enable `RTSP Media` (runtime `RTSPMedia`, editor `RTSPMediaEditor`).
It does real-time media streaming via RTSP (pull into Media Framework).
Create an RTSP Media Source, set the URL, and play live camera/encoder streams in a level.
It is a media-playback extension; requires Media Framework.
note_cn: 经 RTSP 拉实时媒体流到引擎。
note_en: Real-time media streaming into the engine via RTSP.

cn_steps: 启用 `Runtime Tests`（模块 `RuntimeTests`）。
它对编辑器和煮熟包都会用到的运行时代码做自动化测试。
跑这些测试来校验运行时在 Editor 与 cooked 两种环境下的行为。
属测试插件；不要当 Shipping 玩法。
en_steps: Enable `Runtime Tests` (module `RuntimeTests`).
It is automated tests for runtime code used in both editor and cooked builds.
Run these tests to validate runtime behavior in Editor and cooked environments.
It is a test plugin; not a shipping gameplay feature.
note_cn: 覆盖 Editor 与 cooked 运行时的自动化测试。
note_en: Automated tests for runtime code in editor and cooked builds.

cn_steps: 启用 `Sample Mesh Reconstructor`（模块 `DummyMeshReconstructor`）。
它演示如何驱动网格重建：生成虚拟几何来展示 API 用法。
把它当示例参考去接自己的网格重建，而不是当生产重建器。
属示例插件；不要当 Shipping 网格方案。
en_steps: Enable `Sample Mesh Reconstructor` (module `DummyMeshReconstructor`).
It is a sample of how to drive mesh reconstruction: it generates dummy geometry to show the API.
Treat it as a reference when wiring your own reconstructor, not as a production reconstructor.
It is a sample plugin; not a shipping mesh solution.
note_cn: 网格重建 API 的示例（生成虚拟几何）。

cn_steps: 启用 `Sample Tools Editor Mode`（模块 `SampleToolsEditorMode`）。
它包含一组示例工具，展示 Interactive Tools Framework 的能力。
在编辑器 Modes 里打开 Sample Tools，对照实现再写自己的交互工具。
属编辑器示例；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Sample Tools Editor Mode` (module `SampleToolsEditorMode`).
It includes a set of sample tools demonstrating the Interactive Tools Framework.
Open Sample Tools in editor Modes and use the implementations as a starting point for your own tools.
It is an editor sample; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 展示 Interactive Tools Framework 的示例编辑器模式。
note_en: Sample editor mode demonstrating the Interactive Tools Framework.

cn_steps: 启用 `Sandboxes`（模块 `SandboxedEditing`）。
它允许在沙箱环境中编辑文件，改完的文件可以写回主项目。
在试验性编辑时先在沙箱里改，确认后再持久化到主工程。
属编辑器工作流插件；默认不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Sandboxes` (module `SandboxedEditing`).
It allows editing files in sandbox environments; edited files can be persisted into the main project.
Try experimental edits in a sandbox first, then persist into the main project when confirmed.
It is an editor-workflow plugin; it does not ship by default.
note_cn: 在沙箱里编辑文件，确认后再写回主项目。
note_en: Edit files in sandboxes, then persist into the main project.

cn_steps: 启用 `Scene Capture Toolset`（模块 `SceneCaptureToolset`）。
它提供视口视频录制、场景诊断、游戏帧缓冲捕获和编辑器相机捕获。
通过 AI 工具集注册表调用这些捕获工具，而不是当 Shipping 功能。
属 Toolset；一般不进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Scene Capture Toolset` (module `SceneCaptureToolset`).
It provides viewport video recording, scene diagnostics, game framebuffer capture, and editor-camera capture.
Call these capture tools via the AI Toolset Registry; not a shipping gameplay feature.
It is a Toolset; typically not shipped in a cooked game.
note_cn: 视口/帧缓冲/编辑器相机捕获的 AI 工具集。

cn_steps: 启用 `SceneGraphToolset`（模块 `SceneGraphToolset`）。
它通过 AI 工具集注册表只读检查场景图（实体预制件、放置实体、继承链和属性覆盖）。
给编辑器 AI 助手查询场景图结构，而不是当 Shipping 功能。
属实验性只读 Toolset。
en_steps: Enable `SceneGraphToolset` (module `SceneGraphToolset`).
It inspects the Scene Graph read-only via the AI Toolset Registry (entity prefabs, placed entities, inheritance, property overrides).
Let the in-editor AI assistant query scene-graph structure; not a shipping gameplay feature.
It is an experimental read-only Toolset.
note_cn: 只读检查场景图的 AI 工具集。
note_en: Read-only AI toolset to inspect the Scene Graph.

cn_steps: 启用 `ScreenReader`（模块 `ScreenReader`）。
它包含可扩展的无障碍类和框架，用于提供视觉辅助服务。
在此基础上接系统读屏或自定义语音反馈，而不是从零写无障碍层。
属无障碍基础框架；按产品需求扩展。
en_steps: Enable `ScreenReader` (module `ScreenReader`).
It contains accessibility classes and frameworks that can be extended to offer vision accessibility services.
Build system screen-reader or custom speech feedback on top of it instead of writing the a11y layer from scratch.
It is an accessibility foundation framework; extend per product need.
note_cn: 可扩展的视觉无障碍/读屏框架。
